response.sql: SELECT calibrstatus, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct >= 47.6 GROUP BY calibrstatus;

assumptions.assumption: Each row in telescopes is one telescope (telescregistry is the primary key), so COUNT(*) counts telescopes. Telescopes with a NULL calibrstatus form their own group rather than being dropped.
